searchText: Is there a https://blobscan.com for Goerli? will DM some internal tools 😄 Weird the hashes I'm seeing in my geth logs don't seem to match the ones reported in your forkmon UI, I wonder if maybe forkmon wasn't updated w/ the new 4844 fields? uhh that indeed could be? we have some CL data here that might be easier: https://dora.goerli.ethpandaops.io/clients Ya the CL roots match, whew 🙂 thought I ended up on a different fork than you all at first 🙂 Also I feel like https://goerli.etherscan.io is on a different fork? whats the easiest tool to use to generate some blob txs? I want to make sure our systems are handling them end-to-end on goerli we maintain this in case its useful: https://github.com/ethpandaops/goomy-blob Awesome thanks this worked perfectly. For others if you need to send a quick blob tx you can use: `go run cmd/blob-sender/main.go -r <RPC node> --random-privkey -b "random::256"`. Obviously w/ a random privkey you're not going to actually send the tx but you can confirm you node returns insufficient gas (in my case I just wanted to double check that our proxy fronting our nodes that accept `eth_sendRawTransaction` was fully handling blob txs). you can also use `-p <privkey>` if you have a funded throw-away key you want to use. BTW once you can remove the `replace` directive and use upstream geth then `go install github.com/ethpandaops/goomy-blob/cmd/blob-sender@latest` would work w/o needing to clone the repo. Cc <@808969530608451584> ,we can switch to master now 😄 fixed 👍 One other small issue, I submitted a PR.

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content: we maintain this in case its useful: https://github.com/ethpandaops/goomy-blob

excerpts.author: ryanleeschneider
excerpts.content: Awesome thanks this worked perfectly.  For others if you need to send a quick blob tx you can use: `go run cmd/blob-sender/main.go -r <RPC node> --random-privkey -b "random::256"`.  Obviously w/ a random privkey you're not going to actually send the tx but you can confirm you node returns insufficient gas (in my case I just wanted to double check that our proxy fronting our nodes that accept `eth_sendRawTransaction` was fully handling blob txs).  you can also use `-p <privkey>` if you have a funded throw-away key you want to use.

excerpts.author: ryanleeschneider
excerpts.content: BTW once you can remove the `replace` directive and use upstream geth then `go install github.com/ethpandaops/goomy-blob/cmd/blob-sender@latest` would work w/o needing to clone the repo.
